subject: math.SG
name: Darboux's theorem
statement: Near every point of a 2n-dimensional symplectic manifold there are local coordinates (q₁,…,qₙ,p₁,…,pₙ) in which the symplectic form equals ∑ᵢ dqᵢ ∧ dpᵢ.

subject: math.SG
name: Moser stability theorem
statement: For a smooth family ωₜ of symplectic forms on a closed manifold whose de Rham cohomology class is independent of t ∈ [0,1], there is a smooth isotopy φₜ beginning at the identity with φₜ*ωₜ = ω₀.

subject: math.SG
name: Weinstein Lagrangian neighborhood theorem
statement: A neighborhood of a closed embedded Lagrangian submanifold L in a symplectic manifold is symplectomorphic to a neighborhood of the zero section in the cotangent bundle T*L with its canonical symplectic form. The symplectomorphism restricts to the identity on L.

subject: math.SG
name: Symplectic neighborhood theorem
statement: For compact symplectic submanifolds in symplectic manifolds, a symplectomorphism of the submanifolds together with an isomorphism of their symplectic normal bundles extends to a symplectomorphism between neighborhoods.

subject: math.SG
name: Marsden–Weinstein reduction theorem
statement: If a Lie group acts in a Hamiltonian way with equivariant moment map μ, zero is a regular value of μ, and the group action on μ⁻¹(0) is free and proper, then μ⁻¹(0)/G is a smooth symplectic manifold. Its symplectic form pulls back to the restriction of the original form.

subject: math.SG
name: Liouville–Arnold theorem
statement: On a 2n-dimensional symplectic manifold, a compact connected common regular level of n independent pairwise Poisson-commuting smooth functions is an n-torus. A neighborhood admits action-angle coordinates in which the commuting Hamiltonian flows are linear in the angle variables.

subject: math.SG
name: Atiyah–Guillemin–Sternberg convexity theorem
statement: For a Hamiltonian torus action on a compact connected symplectic manifold, the image of the moment map is a convex polytope equal to the convex hull of the images of the fixed points.

references.title: Lectures on Symplectic Geometry — Ana Cannas da Silva, Theorem 27.1

subject: math.SG
name: Delzant's classification theorem
statement: Compact connected 2n-dimensional symplectic manifolds with an effective Hamiltonian n-torus action are classified, up to equivariant symplectomorphism, by their moment polytopes up to translation. These polytopes are simple, rational, and smooth: primitive integral edge directions at each vertex form a lattice basis; translating the moment map translates the polytope.

subject: math.SG
name: Duistermaat–Heckman theorem
statement: For an effective Hamiltonian torus action on a compact connected symplectic manifold, the pushforward of symplectic volume by the moment map has a density that is polynomial on each connected chamber of regular values.

subject: math.SG
name: Gromov non-squeezing theorem
statement: For n ≥ 2, a standard symplectic open ball of radius r in Euclidean 2n-space embeds symplectically into the cylinder B²(R) × Euclidean (2n−2)-space if and only if r ≤ R.

subject: math.SG
name: Gromov compactness theorem for holomorphic curves
statement: For a closed symplectic manifold with a fixed compatible almost complex structure, a sequence of stable pseudoholomorphic maps with fixed genus, number of marked points, and homology class has a subsequence converging, after reparametrization in the Gromov topology, to a stable nodal pseudoholomorphic map. The limit includes sphere bubbles that account for concentrated energy.

subject: math.SG
name: Arnold fixed-point theorem in the aspherical case
statement: Let a closed symplectic manifold satisfy ω|π₂ = 0 and c₁|π₂ = 0. Every Hamiltonian diffeomorphism with nondegenerate fixed points has at least the sum of the Betti numbers of the manifold with coefficients in ℤ/2ℤ many fixed points.

subject: math.SG
name: Cotangent-bundle Lagrangian intersection theorem
statement: For a closed manifold Q, any Hamiltonian image of the zero section of T*Q that intersects the zero section transversely has at least the sum of the ℤ/2ℤ Betti numbers of Q many intersection points. The Hamiltonian isotopy may be taken compactly supported.

subject: math.SG
name: Gromov's exact Lagrangian obstruction
statement: Standard symplectic Euclidean 2n-space contains no closed embedded Lagrangian submanifold on which the standard Liouville one-form is exact.

subject: math.SG
name: Weinstein conjecture in dimension three
statement: The Reeb vector field of every contact form on a closed oriented three-manifold has a periodic orbit. The Reeb vector field R is characterized by α(R) = 1 and dα(R,·) = 0.

subject: math.SG
name: Gray stability theorem
statement: A smooth one-parameter family of cooriented contact structures on a closed manifold is carried to the initial contact structure by a smooth isotopy beginning at the identity.

subject: math.SG
name: Boothby–Wang theorem
statement: If a closed symplectic manifold has integral symplectic cohomology class, there is a principal circle bundle over it with a connection one-form α satisfying dα = π*ω. The form α is a contact form, and its Reeb flow follows the circle fibers, with the circle normalized as ℝ/ℤ.

subject: math.SG
name: Hofer nondegeneracy theorem
statement: On a closed connected symplectic manifold, the infimum over Hamiltonians generating a Hamiltonian diffeomorphism of ∫₀¹(max Hₜ − min Hₜ)dt is strictly positive for every nonidentity diffeomorphism. Together with this length construction it defines Hofer's metric.

references.title: Lectures on Groups of Symplectomorphisms — Dusa McDuff, Section 1.1

subject: math.SG
name: Flux exact-sequence theorem
statement: For a closed connected symplectic manifold, the flux homomorphism induces an isomorphism from the identity component of the symplectomorphism group modulo its Hamiltonian subgroup to H¹(M;ℝ)/Γ, where Γ is the flux group of loops of symplectomorphisms.

references.title: Lectures on Groups of Symplectomorphisms — Dusa McDuff, Section 1.1

subject: math.SG
name: Banyaga simplicity theorem
statement: For a closed connected symplectic manifold of positive dimension, the group of Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms is a simple group: its only normal subgroups are the trivial subgroup and the entire group.

references.title: Lectures on Groups of Symplectomorphisms — Dusa McDuff, Section 1.1
